///- --package . --timeout 2400000
open xml_codec

prototype to_text t : t -> string

inl text_node forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : t) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element name [] (xml.text_children (to_text v))

inl optional_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : option t) : list xml.xml_node =
    xml.option_list (optionm.map (text_node name) v)

inl repeated_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (vs : list t) : list xml.xml_node =
    listm.map (text_node name) vs

union complement =
    | TimbreFiscalDigital11 : generated_cfdi_tfd_1_1.x_timbre_fiscal_digital
    | Pagos20 : generated_cfdi_pagos_2_0.x_pagos
    | Unknown : xml.xml_node

inl complement_namespace (node : xml.xml_node) : string =
    inl name = xml.node_name node
    inl colon = sm'.index_of ":" name
    inl key = if colon >= 0i32 then sm'.(++#) "xmlns:" (sm'.substring 0i32 colon name) else "xmlns"
    match xml.attribute_of key (xml.element_attributes node) with
    | Some uri => uri
    | None => ""

inl complement_of_xml (node : xml.xml_node) : complement =
    inl local = xml.local_name (xml.node_name node)
    inl space = complement_namespace node
    if local = "TimbreFiscalDigital" && (space = "" || space = "http://www.sat.gob.mx/TimbreFiscalDigital") then
        xml_codec.decoded_or
            fun v => TimbreFiscalDigital11 v
            (Unknown node)
            (generated_cfdi_tfd_1_1.x_timbre_fiscal_digital_of_xml node)
    elif local = "Pagos" && (space = "" || space = "http://www.sat.gob.mx/Pagos20")
    then xml_codec.decoded_or (fun v => Pagos20 v) (Unknown node) (generated_cfdi_pagos_2_0.x_pagos_of_xml node)
    else Unknown node

inl complement_in (space : string) (node : xml.xml_node) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element (xml.node_name node) (("xmlns", space) :: xml.element_attributes node) (xml.element_children node)

inl complement_to_xml (x : complement) : xml.xml_node =
    match x with
    | TimbreFiscalDigital11 v =>
        complement_in
            "http://www.sat.gob.mx/TimbreFiscalDigital"
            (generated_cfdi_tfd_1_1.x_timbre_fiscal_digital_to_xml "TimbreFiscalDigital" v)
    | Pagos20 v => complement_in "http://www.sat.gob.mx/Pagos20" (generated_cfdi_pagos_2_0.x_pagos_to_xml "Pagos" v)
    | Unknown node => node
type any_content = list complement

inl any_content_of (nodes : list xml.xml_node) : any_content = listm.map complement_of_xml nodes

inl any_content_to (content : any_content) : list xml.xml_node = listm.map complement_to_xml content

nominal private x_c_municipio = string

inl x_c_municipio_table () : string =
    "0 48-48>078 49-52>066 53-53>032\n0 48-54>100 55-55>054\n0 48-48>124\n0 48-57>100\n0 48-48>112 49-57>100\n"
    ^^ "0 48-57>124\n0 49-57>124\n1\n"

inl x_c_municipio_of_string (s : string) : option x_c_municipio =
    inl s = xml.collapsed_space s
    if xsd_regex.table_matches (x_c_municipio_table ()) s then Some (x_c_municipio s) else None

inl x_c_municipio_to_string (x : x_c_municipio) : string = match x with x_c_municipio s => s
instance to_text x_c_municipio = fun x => x_c_municipio_to_string x

inl x_c_municipio_example (k : i32) : x_c_municipio =
    inl index = ((k % 8i32) + 8i32) % 8i32
    if index = 0i32 then x_c_municipio "001"
    elif index = 1i32 then x_c_municipio "002"
    elif index = 2i32 then x_c_municipio "003"
    elif index = 3i32 then x_c_municipio "004"
    elif index = 4i32 then x_c_municipio "005"
    elif index = 5i32 then x_c_municipio "006"
    elif index = 6i32 then x_c_municipio "007"
    else x_c_municipio "008"

inl x_c_municipio_example_text (k : i32) : string = x_c_municipio_to_string (x_c_municipio_example k)

inl x_c_clave_unidad_of_string (s : string) : option x_c_clave_unidad =
    inl s = xml.collapsed_space s
    if xsd_regex.table_matches (x_c_clave_unidad_table ()) s then Some (x_c_clave_unidad s) else None

inl x_c_clave_unidad_to_string (x : x_c_clave_unidad) : string = match x with x_c_clave_unidad s => s
instance to_text x_c_clave_unidad = fun x => x_c_clave_unidad_to_string x

inl x_c_clave_unidad_example (k : i32) : x_c_clave_unidad =
    inl index = ((k % 8i32) + 8i32) % 8i32
    if index = 0i32 then x_c_clave_unidad "18"
    elif index = 1i32 then x_c_clave_unidad "19"
    elif index = 2i32 then x_c_clave_unidad "26"
    elif index = 3i32 then x_c_clave_unidad "29"
    elif index = 4i32 then x_c_clave_unidad "30"
    elif index = 5i32 then x_c_clave_unidad "31"
    elif index = 6i32 then x_c_clave_unidad "32"
    else x_c_clave_unidad "36"

inl x_c_clave_unidad_example_text (k : i32) : string = x_c_clave_unidad_to_string (x_c_clave_unidad_example k)

nominal private x_c_clave_prod_serv = string

inl x_c_clave_prod_serv_of_string (s : string) : option x_c_clave_prod_serv =
    inl s = xml.collapsed_space s
    if xsd_regex.table_matches (x_c_clave_prod_serv_table ()) s then Some (x_c_clave_prod_serv s) else None

inl x_c_clave_prod_serv_to_string (x : x_c_clave_prod_serv) : string = match x with x_c_clave_prod_serv s => s
instance to_text x_c_clave_prod_serv = fun x => x_c_clave_prod_serv_to_string x

inl x_c_clave_prod_serv_example (k : i32) : x_c_clave_prod_serv =
    inl index = ((k % 8i32) + 8i32) % 8i32
    if index = 0i32 then x_c_clave_prod_serv "01010101"
    elif index = 1i32 then x_c_clave_prod_serv "10101500"
    elif index = 2i32 then x_c_clave_prod_serv "10101501"
    elif index = 3i32 then x_c_clave_prod_serv "10101502"
    elif index = 4i32 then x_c_clave_prod_serv "10101504"
    elif index = 5i32 then x_c_clave_prod_serv "10101505"
    elif index = 6i32 then x_c_clave_prod_serv "10101506"
    else x_c_clave_prod_serv "10101507"

inl x_c_clave_prod_serv_example_text (k : i32) : string = x_c_clave_prod_serv_to_string (x_c_clave_prod_serv_example k)

and let x_comprobante_children (x : x_comprobante) : list xml.xml_node =
    inl nodes forall r. (f : x_comprobante_field r) (v : r) : list xml.xml_node =
        match f with
        | Comprobante_field_InformacionGlobal =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_comprobante_informacion_global_to_xml "InformacionGlobal" v) v)
        | Comprobante_field_CfdiRelacionados =>
            listm.map (fun v => x_comprobante_cfdi_relacionados_to_xml "CfdiRelacionados" v) v
        | Comprobante_field_Emisor => [ x_comprobante_emisor_to_xml "Emisor" v ]
        | Comprobante_field_Receptor => [ x_comprobante_receptor_to_xml "Receptor" v ]
        | Comprobante_field_Conceptos => [ x_comprobante_conceptos_to_xml "Conceptos" v ]
        | Comprobante_field_Impuestos =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_comprobante_impuestos_to_xml "Impuestos" v) v)
        | Comprobante_field_Complemento =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_comprobante_complemento_to_xml "Complemento" v) v)
        | Comprobante_field_Addenda =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_comprobante_addenda_to_xml "Addenda" v) v)
    inl rec walk (fields : list (exists r. x_comprobante_field r)) : list xml.xml_node =
        match fields with
        | packed :: rest =>
            inl exists r. f = packed
            listm.append (nodes f (x_comprobante_get f x)) (walk rest)
        | [] => []
    walk [
        exists Comprobante_field_InformacionGlobal
        exists Comprobante_field_CfdiRelacionados
        exists Comprobante_field_Emisor
        exists Comprobante_field_Receptor
        exists Comprobante_field_Conceptos
        exists Comprobante_field_Impuestos
        exists Comprobante_field_Complemento
        exists Comprobante_field_Addenda
    ]

and let x_comprobante_attributes (x : x_comprobante) : list (string * string) =
    listm.concat [
        [ ("Version", x.version) ]
        xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => "Serie", to_text v) x.serie)
        xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => "Folio", to_text v) x.folio)
        [ ("Fecha", to_text x.fecha) ]
        [ ("Sello", x.sello) ]
        xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => "FormaPago", to_text v) x.forma_pago)
        [ ("NoCertificado", to_text x.no_certificado) ]
        [ ("Certificado", x.certificado) ]
        xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => "CondicionesDePago", to_text v) x.condiciones_de_pago)
        [ ("SubTotal", to_text x.sub_total) ]
        xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => "Descuento", to_text v) x.descuento)
        [ ("Moneda", to_text x.moneda) ]
        xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => "TipoCambio", v) x.tipo_cambio)
        [ ("Total", to_text x.total) ]
        [ ("TipoDeComprobante", to_text x.tipo_de_comprobante) ]
        [ ("Exportacion", to_text x.exportacion) ]
        xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => "MetodoPago", to_text v) x.metodo_pago)
        [ ("LugarExpedicion", to_text x.lugar_expedicion) ]
        xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => "Confirmacion", to_text v) x.confirmacion)
    ]

and let x_comprobante_to_xml (name : string) (x : x_comprobante) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element name (x_comprobante_attributes x) (x_comprobante_children x)

///- --test
///> rust

inl example = x_comprobante_example 0i32
inl document =
    xml.element
        "Comprobante"
        (("xmlns", "http://www.sat.gob.mx/cfd/4") :: x_comprobante_attributes example)
        (x_comprobante_children example)
file_system.directory_create_all (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "") |> ignore
file_system.write_all_text
    (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "generated_cfdi_v4_0_example.xml")
    (xml.write_node (xml.with_namespace "Signature" "http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#" document))
inl documents = [ "deps/corpus/mx/stamped/cfdiutils-cfdi40-valid.xml" ]
inl check (path : string) : list string =
    inl text = file_system.read_all_text (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path (sm'.(++#) "../" path))
    match xml.read_xml text with
    | node :: [] =>
        match xml_codec.read_back_difference (x_comprobante_of_xml) (x_comprobante_to_xml "Comprobante") node with
        | Some difference => [ sm'.(++#) path (sm'.(++#) ": " difference) ]
        | None => []
    | _ => [ sm'.(++#) path ": not one root element" ]
inl failures = listm.concat (listm.map check documents)
inl _ =
    match failures with
    | first :: _ =>
        inl count = sm'.obj_to_string (listm.length failures : i32)
        inl message = sm'.(++#) " real documents do not read back unchanged; first: " first
        failwith (sm'.(++#) count message)
    | [] => ()
inl text = file_system.read_all_text (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "generated_cfdi_v4_0_example.xml")
let rec runs (left : i32) (parses : list i64) (writes : list i64) (bytes : i64) : list i64 * list i64 * i64 =
    if left = 0i32 then parses, writes, bytes
    else
        inl watch = date_time.stopwatch ()
        date_time.stopwatch_start watch
        inl start = date_time.stopwatch_elapsed_microseconds watch
        match xml.read_xml text with
        | node :: [] =>
            inl parsed = xml_codec.expect_decoded (x_comprobante_of_xml node)
            inl parsed_at = date_time.stopwatch_elapsed_microseconds watch
            inl written = xml.write_node (x_comprobante_to_xml "Comprobante" parsed)
            inl written_at = date_time.stopwatch_elapsed_microseconds watch
            inl parses = generated_fiscal_runtime.insert_run (parsed_at - start) parses
            inl writes = generated_fiscal_runtime.insert_run (written_at - parsed_at) writes
            runs (left - 1i32) parses writes (bytes + sm'.length written)
        | _ => failwith "one Comprobante element"
inl _ = runs (dyn 5i32) [] [] 0i64
inl parses, writes, bytes = runs (dyn 31i32) [] [] 0i64
inl row = sm'.(++#) "generated_cfdi_v4_0 parse_us " (generated_fiscal_runtime.median parses)
inl row = sm'.(++#) row (sm'.(++#) " write_us " (generated_fiscal_runtime.median writes))
inl row = sm'.(++#) row (sm'.(++#) " runs 31 bytes " (sm'.obj_to_string bytes))
console.write_line row
match xml.read_xml text with
| node :: [] =>
    inl parsed = xml_codec.expect_decoded (x_comprobante_of_xml node)
    inl document =
        xml.element
            "Comprobante"
            (("xmlns", "http://www.sat.gob.mx/cfd/4") :: x_comprobante_attributes parsed)
            (x_comprobante_children parsed)
    inl folder = generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "../target/bench"
    match file_system.directory_create_all folder with
    | Ok _ =>
        file_system.write_all_text
            (sm'.(++#) folder "/ours-generated_cfdi_v4_0_example.xml")
            (xml.write_node (xml.with_namespace "Signature" "http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#" document))
    | Error _ => failwith "cannot create target/bench"
| _ => failwith "one Comprobante element"
